units.source_text: 源氏公子排场并不盛大，服装也很朴素，连前驱也不用，微行前往。

en.t: Prince Genji set out quietly, without any grand display; his clothing was plain, and he did not even use outriders.

units.source_text: 经过中川近旁，便看见一座小小的邸宅，庭中树木颇有雅趣。

en.t: As he passed near Nakagawa, he saw a small mansion whose garden trees had a distinctly elegant charm.

units.source_text: 但闻里面传出音色美好的筝与和琴的合奏声，弹得幽艳动人，源氏公子听赏了一会。

en.t: From within came the beautiful tones of a koto and a wagon playing together, so subtly enchanting that Genji listened for a while in appreciation.

units.source_text: 车子离门甚近，他便从车中探出头来，向门内张望。

en.t: Since the carriage was very close to the gate, he leaned his head out and looked inside.

units.source_text: 庭中高大的桂花树顺风飘过香气来，令人联想贺茂祭时节。

en.t: The fragrance of the tall osmanthus tree in the garden drifted on the wind, calling to mind the season of the Kamo Festival.

units.source_text: 看到四周一带的风趣，他便忆起这是以前曾经欢度一宵的人家，不禁心动。

en.t: Seeing the atmosphere of the place around him, he remembered that this was the house where he had once spent a delightful night, and his heart was stirred.

units.source_text: 他想：“阔别多时了，那人还记得我么？”

en.t: He thought, "It has been so long since we parted; does she still remember me?"
At that thought, his courage faltered.

units.source_text: 然而不能过门不入，一时犹豫不决。

en.t: Yet he could not simply pass the gate without going in, and for a time he wavered, unable to decide.

units.source_text: 正在此时，忽闻杜鹃的叫声，似乎在挽留行人，便命回车，照例派惟光进去，传达一首诗：

en.t: Just then, he suddenly heard the cry of a cuckoo, as if it were detaining the traveler; so he ordered the carriage turned back and, as usual, sent Koremitsu inside to deliver a poem:
